exposure: Coagulation factors (FII, FV, FIX, FX, FXI, FVIII, FXIII)
cohort: The study included 52 consecutive women who experienced postpartum hemorrhage of unknown cause and 52 matched controls without PPH.
finding: Women with PPH of unknown cause showed reduced activity of several coagulation factors and formed a looser, more permeable plasma fibrin network with shorter clot lysis time, with PPH being independently associated with higher C-reactive protein, lower FII, lower FV, and shorter clot lysis time.
cross-section timing: At least 3 months after postpartum hemorrhage
